name: Maya the Bat Final
author: lilrodent
description:
Maya the Bat Final Build. 
Collect all the treats as fast as you can! Use the arrow or WASD keys to turn and spacebar to activate a speed boost. Press esc to pause.
When in 2 player mode, player 1 uses WASD + Space and player 2 uses arrow and Right Ctrl. 

Github: https://github.com/chloewoods/MayaGame/tree/main
Schedule reflections: https://github.com/chloewoods/MayaGame/blob/main/README.md
